paragraphs.text: i consider sugar to be my first adult album. i made it right after graduating high school, but before starting college. it's certainly a covid album, but also a deeply adolescent one. i think i was going for something really poppy and sweet, but i really was not good at editing or certainly, cutting, so there are some tracks that make no sense being on this album. theming woes nonwithstanding, i still like this album. it's an ameature one for sure, but it's cute and fun.
